english:
In the Evening, for tomorrow's blessing:
Say two [Hambartsi] hymns, and
perform the pre-festal office [Nakhatonak] of the Fathers with its proper canons.
But on the last, ninth day of the evening [Hambartsi], say the [Ter Herknits] of the same day:
Tone 6 [Dza]: "Rejoice, O unutterable Mother" (Urakh ler mayr anchar).

Tuesday: On the ninth day after the Assumption of the Holy Mother of God, it is the Feast of Joachim and Anna (the parents of the Holy Mother of God) and of the Myrrh-bearing Women.
Resurrection Canon Tone 2 [Ak]: "He who foreknew" (Vor nakhimats), with its proper canons.
Magnificat [Mankunk] Tone 2 [Ak]: "Disciples of Christ" (Ashakertq Qristosi).
Hambartsi Tone 8 [Dk]: "Of the Myrrh-bearing" (Yughaberits).
Midday Introit: "Apostles" (Araqyalq).
Antiphon: "I loved" (Siretsi).
Hymn Tone 6 [Dza]: "Who in the heights" (Vor i bardzrutyunsq).
Psalm 95 [96]: "Proclaim..." Antiphon: "Bless the Lord with a blessing" (Orhnetseq zter yorhnutyun).
Proverbs [Wisdom] 9:6: "The Lord is with you..." to 10:2: "to have all."
Book of Esther 10:9: "And Mordecai said..." to 9: "our evils."
Book of Judith 15:8: "And when the sons..." to 16:4: "in the midst of the people."
Apostle [Epistle to the] Ephesians 1:3: "Blessed be God..." to verse 12: "who hoped in Christ."
Alleluia: "You shall make them princes."
Gospel according to Matthew 1:17: "So all the generations..." to verse 21: "from their sins."

Wednesday: Canticle of Penitence [Harts].
Midday Psalm 85 [86]: "Preserve your servant" (Ketso ztsarays).
Apostle [1st Epistle to the] Corinthians 15:58: "Therefore, brethren..." to 16:11: "with the brethren."
Gospel according to Mark 4:10: "And when he was..." to verse 20: "some thirtyfold and some an hundred."

Thursday: Of the Holy Prophet Jeremiah.
Resurrection Canon Tone 2 [Ak]: "He who the divine" (Vor zastvatsayin).
Canticle [Harts] Tone 1 [Ad]: "Who in the heavenly" (Vor yerknayin), with its proper canons.
Magnificat [Metsatsustse]: "To you revealed" (Yzqez yerevyal).
Midday Introit: "Lord, who established" (Ter vor himnetsutser).
Hymn Tone 1 [Ad]: "Ray of light" (Charagayt).
Psalm 39 [40]: "He drew me" (Ehan zis).
Prophet Jeremiah 1:1: "The word of God..." to verse 10: "to build and to plant."
Again, Jeremiah 38:1: "And Shephatiah heard..." to verse 13: "in the court of the prison."
Catholic [2nd Epistle of] Peter 2:9: "The Lord knows..." to verse 22: "wallowing."
Alleluia: "He drew me out of the pit."
Gospel according to Matthew 2:16: "Then when he saw..." to verse 18: "because they were not."

Friday: Canticle of Rest [Harts].
Midday Psalm 97 [98]: "They saw all" (Tesin amenayn).
Apostle [1st Epistle to the] Corinthians 16:12: "Now concerning Apollos..." to verse 24: "Jesus, Amen."
Alleluia: According to the Tone of the day.
Gospel according to Mark 4:26: "And he said, So is..." to verse 24: "he explained all."

Saturday: Of the Holy Apostles Thomas, James, and Simon.
Resurrection Canon Tone 5 [Gz]: "Blessed holy apostles" (Yraneli surb araqyalq), with its proper canons.
Magnificat [Metsatsustse] Tone 1 [Ad]: "Today a new people" (Aysor nor zhoghovurdq).
Magnificat [Mankunk] Tone 2 [Ak]: "Disciples of Christ" (Ashakertq Qristosi).
Psalm 18 [19]: "Through all the earth" (Ynd amenayn yerkir).
Proverbs [Wisdom] 9:13: "For who is the man..." to 10:3: "with anger."
Prophet Micah 7:18: "Who is a God..." to verse 20: "of old."
Apostle [1st Epistle to the] Corinthians 12:28: "And God has appointed..." to 13:3: "it profits me nothing."
Alleluia: "You shall make them."
Gospel according to John 20:24: "But Thomas..." to verse 31: "in his name."
In the Evening: "Joyous Light" (Luys zvart).
Mesedi: "I loved, for he inclined" (Siretsi. Zi khonarhytsoyg).
Hambartsi Tone 1 [Ad]: "Holy art Thou, Lord" (Surb es ter) and "Of Thee we entreat" (I qen haytsemq).
Glory: "Now implore" (Ard aghachya).
Now and ever: "And ascended" (Ev hambartsyal).
And at the conclusion, perform the pre-festal office [Nakhatonak] of the Holy Mother of God: Tone 2 [Ak], "He who foreknew" (Vor nakhimats), with its proper canons.

Fifth Sunday after the Assumption of the Holy Mother of God: Feast of the Discovery of the Belt [Goti] of the Holy Mother of God.
Resurrection Canon Tone 6 [Gk]: "Sing, O children" (Yergetseq vordiq), with its proper canons.
Alleluia: Of the Nativity.
Morning Song: "He shall come down like rain" (Ijtsye vorpes zandzrev).
Proclamation [Karoz]: "Holy Mother" (Mayr surb).
Psalm 109 [110]: "In the beauty... The Lord said unto my Lord" (I vayelchutyun. Asats ter ts'ter).
Gospel according to Luke 1:39: "Mary arose..." to verse 56: "to her own house."
Afterwards: "Newly created" (Norasteghtsyal).
Proclamation [Karoz]: "Let us ask... Save us" (Khndresgup. Ketso).
Prayer: "Your almighty" (Qum amenazor).
At Midday: Everything is of the Resurrection.
Psalm 64 [65]: "Praise is due to You" (Qez vayel e).
Prophet Isaiah 9:8: "Death was released..." to verse 19: "as of fire."
Mesedi of the Resurrection according to the Tone of the day.
Apostle [2nd Epistle to the] Corinthians 1:1: "Paul, an apostle..." to verse 12: "thanksgiving on our behalf."
Alleluia: Of the Resurrection according to the Tone of the day.
Gospel according to Mark [continues...]
